verdict.rationale: Jan is open source (jan-gh-12), and its README describes a source build command that 'installs dependencies, builds core components, and launches the app' (jan-gh-7), so building from source is a documented first-party path. Nothing shows the dependency footprint is minimal; the build step that installs dependencies suggests a non-trivial toolchain. missing for 10: documented prerequisite and toolchain list, evidence of a minimal or self-contained dependency set, detailed build-from-source docs, hands-on corroboration of a successful build.
